name: decision-map
description: >- Turn a loose idea into a git-tracked, session-resumable map of typed investigation tickets, then drive them to resolution one at a time. The planning-loop engine for work that is still being figured out — too fuzzy for a campaign, too big for a single intake item. Resolved tickets graduate into .planning/intake/ for the autopilot to build.
author: SethGammon
summary_zh: 一个用 Git 跟踪、可跨会话续接的规划工具，把模糊的大想法拆成调查任务逐个推进，最终转为可执行的开发事项。
